source_visual_observations: Circle O with center dot; tangent AB below circle; secant AC passes through O; radius OB and chord BC; A=36°.
audit.independent_solution: The tangent AB is perpendicular to OB. In right triangle AOB, AOB=90-36=54 degrees. Since A,O,C are collinear, BOC=180-54=126 degrees. OB=OC, so angle OCB=(180-126)/2=27 degrees, choice D.
